execution.authentication_boundary: KMAC authenticates C_0 before witness recovery, body parsing, graph construction, or plaintext reconstruction

hmmm: Whether the exact byte-provenance relation warrants a typed origin transport, synchronization, traversal, or event-promotion law remains unresolved; v1 supplies none of those laws.

canonical_graph.representation: canonical graph shards plus cross-trace edges; every shard's complete nodes and edges are embedded in measurement.traces

capacities.evidence: every successor byte and occurrence bit span is mapped to the exact predecessor LayerWire; inverse expansion is byte-identical
capacities.limitations: no semantic predecessor-origin correspondence is defined across a serialization boundary

capacities.evidence: authenticated_body_mutation fails at tag verification before witness parsing
capacities.limitations: v1 rejects the frame but supplies no authenticated subframe localization law

capacities.evidence: replay_after_advance fails under K_(t+1); concurrent_state_rejection admits exactly one host CAS commit
capacities.limitations: no durable fork recovery, rollback resistance, or reconciliation law

capacities.evidence: attachment components are rooted forests and serialization/state provenance is forward-only; the complete graph contains no directed cycle
capacities.limitations: a nontrivial holonomy test requires a native cycle relation that v1 does not provide

capacities.evidence: pairing and attachment are origin-scoped; serialization creates successor origins without an origin-to-origin transport edge
capacities.missing_law: typed relation Sync(origin_a local state, origin_b local state) -> agreement/divergence result with deterministic inverse or declared information loss
capacities.owner: The-Interdependency/stack in a separately versioned experimental profile

capacities.evidence: all occurrence intervals reconstruct each region and all regions reconstruct the predecessor byte stream
capacities.limitations: any omitted byte/bit interval is ambiguous; v1 defines no redundancy or erasure recovery

capacities.capacity: stable interlacing of three, five, and seven logical streams
capacities.evidence: v1 has no logical-stream identity or interlace/deinterlace mapping
capacities.missing_law: Interlace(stream identities, ordered payloads, origin provenance) -> reversible carrier relation for arities 3, 5, and 7
capacities.owner: The-Interdependency/stack in a separately versioned experimental profile

capacities.capacity: contextual authorization requiring complete relational agreement
capacities.evidence: KMAC authenticates C_0 and associated data; no authorization predicate consumes the graph
capacities.missing_law: Authorize(subject, action, complete relational state, policy identity) -> decision with fail-closed completeness rules
capacities.owner: host/application policy owner; not UCNS geometry

capacities.capacity: promotion of transformation events into the next recursive layer
capacities.evidence: 2 analyzed traces feed exact serialized result bytes into successor layers
capacities.missing_law: Promote(event identity, inputs, outputs, provenance) -> typed next-layer object with canonical inverse
capacities.owner: The-Interdependency/stack in a separately versioned experimental profile

relation_audit.cross_layer_boundary: serialization relates a whole source layer to successor input spans; it does not define semantic origin-to-origin phase transport
relation_audit.invertibility: byte-exact when the complete authenticated successor layer and witness are present
relation_audit.native_relation: LayerWire(G^r) is the exact byte input D^(r+1), then partitioned into successor region origins and occurrence bit intervals
relation_audit.within_layer_boundary: pairing and attachment relate objects only inside one origin; no relation joins peer origins

serialization_boundaries.information_lost_at_byte_serialization: none; canonical LayerWire re-encoding and inverse expansion are byte-identical

projection_reversibility.complete_relational_history: replays the analyzed trace exactly but adds no missing semantic law
projection_reversibility.identity_local_state: does not recover absolute winding or complete provenance

serialization_boundaries.relations_erased: no byte information is erased, but typed source relations are not promoted as typed successor relations
relations_preserved: complete layer object recoverable from those bytes

torsor_invariance.law: ((phi_b+k)-(phi_a+k)) mod M = (phi_b-phi_a) mod M; sheet product unchanged
